title: How to Create Video Logo Removal with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to remove a logo from a video using an optional logo reference and motion mode, including setup, request fields, tool…
operation: Remove a logo from a video using an optional logo reference and motion mode.
prompt: Remove a logo from a video using an optional logo reference and motion mode.

fields.name: logo_file_id
fields.purpose: Optional logo image file id used to build the logo mask session.

fields.name: video_size
fields.purpose: Optional original video size hint as [width, height].

fields.name: logo_type
fields.purpose: Logo motion mode for mask generation. Default: moving. Default: moving.

fields.name: model_id
fields.purpose: Video logo removal model id. Default: video-logo-removal-default.
